name: fig1_qa_pipeline
caption: FactoryBench Q&A Generation Pipeline
context: A publication-quality horizontal pipeline diagram for a NeurIPS 2026 benchmark paper. The pipeline shows how industrial robot telemetry is transformed into verified Q&A pairs. Five sequential stages connected by thick rightward arrows on a clean white background.
layout: horizontal left-to-right, five equally-sized rounded-rectangle boxes connected by solid dark-blue arrows, centered vertically on the page. Two floating callout bubbles: one above the pipeline (between boxes 3 and 4) and one below (below box 3). All text in the diagram must be exactly as specified — do not invent or paraphrase any label or callout text.
